summary: stui says offline only when st also fails a fresh request; a lost live stream while st answers shows the reason and reconnects, and each lost stream is logged

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: Published schema, operations and contract digest are unchanged.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: stui-local status change only; the daemon, the Swift and TypeScript clients and the wire are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes. stui writes a bounded connection.log under its state directory.
